title: First Launch and Home Screen
trigger: User starts OpenKaava for the first time

steps.action: OpenKaava launches with a splash screen that waits for all built-in apps to report ready
The main window appears with the title bar, switcher bar, and the Home app ready
Home displays with Start section (New Project, Open Project, Clone Project, Install App buttons), Recents below, and Tutorials column on the right

outcome: OpenKaava loads with the Home app on screen, showing recent projects and options to create, open, or clone a project
